method: All source words, senses, examples, supplied dictionary evidence and classification proposals independently read. Source and proposal hashes bound. Minimum one example policy; no new example obligation. No membership, alias, profile merge or content modification approval.
notes: 改札(口) needs a single dictionary/form decision.
片方 has no source level; N4 is an editorial recommendation for one of a pair.
会計 and 皮 have broader word meanings than current example senses; classification acceptance does not resolve content scope.
